title: Amazon and Anduril put a data center in a shipping container
description:
Amazon and Anduril just packed a full data center inside a shipping container you can send anywhere.

It's called Menace. Anduril has made the container itself for three years, but the new part is that Amazon's cloud now lives inside it. That gives you compute, storage and AI processing that run on their own, even with no internet and no link to any outside server.

The idea is simple. Drones, cameras and sensors create a massive stream of data every second, and sending all of it thousands of miles to the cloud is too slow. So the computing goes straight to where the data is created instead.

Two regular operators, no special training, bring it online in under 10 minutes. You can truck it, fly it, or sling it under a helicopter. It's already running in real conditions where a normal data center could never go.
